title: Fusion observation
description: One source saying one thing about one fused-ball pair. One JSON object per line in a <source>.jsonl harvest file. See README.md for the contract.

pair.description: Canonical ball ids (see aliases.json / src/data/balls.ts), sorted alphabetically. A pair, not a triple. Omit entirely only for kind=composition-rule global rules (e.g. name format, merge model) that name no specific pair.

in_game_name.description: The fused name as the source writes it, e.g. "Bleed X Freeze". Optional for rule/kind-only observations.

order_as_named.description: Component names in the order the source names them (fusion order matters for name/sprite only).

text.description: Verbatim quote from the source (tooltip text, post wording, rule wording). Never paraphrased. For screenshots, the caption/tooltip transcription. For name-only, the sentence that names the pair.

claims.description: Structured interpretation of the text. Your wording lives here; the quote stays in text.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the source content (post date, screenshot date). Access date goes in access_date.

game_version.description: Build/version the observation refers to, if known; else "unknown".

confidence.description: observed = we/author verified it; reported = self-reported by a source; contradicted = conflicts with another observation (keep both); rule-derived = produced by applying composition rules, not found in a source (should be rare in harvest files).
